hook: Your drive through Thimphu has no traffic lights.
title: Your Drive in Bhutan's Capital Has No Lights
description:
Thimphu, the capital of Bhutan, has no traffic lights. A police officer directs the cars by hand instead. Bhutan is also famous for measuring Gross National Happiness. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Bhutan #Geography
